title: Staff Solutions Architect, AI Subject Matter Expert

description_html:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.



About The Role
We’re looking for a Technical Program Manager who can work across engineering, product, and business teams. You’ll bring the technical judgment to earn engineers’ trust and the ability to create clarity and momentum across complex programs. This is a hands-on role with executive visibility and direct impact on how Ramp’s engineering organization scales.


You’re energized by complexity and curious about how AI can improve the way engineering teams work. You experiment with AI tools yourself, understand how they are changing software development, and bring that perspective to the programs you lead.



What You’ll Do

 - Lead large technical programs across engineering and partner teams, from infrastructure scaling to reliability and incident response.

 - Connect platform and product engineering teams, keep context flowing, surface dependencies, and drive effective execution.

 - Own programs from scoping and kickoff through delivery, measurement, and retrospective.

 - Partner with engineering leaders on roadmaps, identify how projects overlap or depend on one another, and keep programs aligned with organizational goals.

 - Help engineers, engineering managers, and partner teams communicate business and engineering priorities across the organization.

 - Strengthen Ramp’s incident response program by improving processes, facilitating retrospectives, and helping teams act on what they learn.

 - Help define how TPMs work at Ramp by setting standards, creating playbooks, and improving program practices.



What You’ll Need

 - 5+ years of technical program management experience, ideally in a high-growth startup.

 - Hands-on fluency with AI tools such as Cursor or Claude Code, and a point of view on how they can improve day-to-day work and software development.

 - The ability to execute directly while improving how the broader team works.

 - A track record of building trust quickly and working effectively across teams.

 - A BA/BS in computer science, engineering, information systems, analytics, or another technical or analytical field.

 - Strong systems thinking: you can connect architecture, product, compliance, and timelines, and spot risks early.

 - Experience leading cross-functional programs toward ambitious goals with urgency and ownership.



Nice To Haves

 - Experience with cell-based or multi-region architectures, or international expansion.

 - Hands-on experience with infrastructure, CI/CD, or observability tools.

 - Experience leading reliability programs.

 - Experience building programs in rigorous, fast-moving organizations.

 - A background in software engineering.

 - Familiarity with how LLM-based systems are built and deployed, enough to have substantive conversations with the engineers building them.




BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

 - Flexible PTO

 - Centralized home-office equipment ordering

 - Health and wellness stipend

 - Budget for intra-office travel

 - Weekly coffee stipend




UNITED STATES

 - 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

 - One Medical annual membership

 - 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

 - Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

 - Pet insurance

 - In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

 - Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)
   
   


CANADA

 - Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

 - Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

 - Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

 - Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

 - Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health




UNITED KINGDOM

 - Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

 - Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

 - Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

title: SRE Systems Engineer (TS/SCI Clearance)
description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Software Engineering    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.         The Experience      Join our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team, where you work alongside Infrastructure and Research and Development partners to keep Salesforce cloud services available for customers around the clock.    With Agentforce woven into every layer of our platform, you help build resilient systems that millions of customers depend on every day.    This role is based in Herndon, VA and is eligible for an onsite work arrangement.    Candidates must have an active TS/SCI with Polygraph clearance.        What You'll Actually Be Doing      Monitor customer-facing services and respond to Severity 0 and Severity 1 incidents, leading technical reviews and contributing to root cause analyses. You are familiar with Agile processes and DevOps practices. title: Senior Solutions Architect, Gen AI
description_html: NVIDIA is building the world’s leading AI company, and we are looking for a Solutions Architect skilled in full cycle Gen AI development and deployment to assist customers with adoption of NVIDIA's full-stack technologies as well as building and deploying solutions around Generative AI and other related GPU-accelerated technologies in which intelligent agents can learn, reason, and interact with the world. As part of the Hospitality and Travel Solutions Architecture team, we work with some of key hotel and transportation chains to integrate accelerated computing and AI into their stacks. A Solutions Architect is the first line of technical expertise between NVIDIA and our Auto customers so you will engage directly with developers, researchers, and data scientists with some the most strategic customers as well as work directly with business and engineering teams on product strategy as it pertains to these customers. Join us in this exciting endeavor!     What You Will Be Doing:     Provide hands-on technical mentorship to partners and customers on Nvidia GenAI stack. Guide customers to develope and deploy Agentic AI workflows on our platforms, quantifying the benefits of our accelerated computing software and hardware.    Build demonstrations and POCs for solutions that address critical business needs of our customers. Help in draft requirements for missing features to unblock progress at customers/partners.    Educate customers on new NVIDIA GenAI technologies and platforms. Prepare and deliver technical training presentations and workshops.    Build collateral (notebook/ blog) applied to the industry use-cases.    Partner with NVIDIA engineering, product, sales teams to secure design wins at customers. Enable development and growth of NVIDIA product features through customer feedback and POC evaluations.       What We Need To See:     Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience.    8+ years of hands-on experience in a technical AI role, with a strong emphasis on Gen AI.     Proficient in the latest and greatest model architectures and be able to articulate the computational complexities of each.     Proven track record of deploying and optimizing LLM models for inference in production environments using well known inferencing engines e.g., vLLM, TRT-LLM, SGLang, etc.    Expertise in training and fine-tuning LLMs using popular frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face Transformers.    Solid understanding of GPU cluster architecture and the ability to bring to bear parallel processing for accelerated model training and inference.    Experience with basic DevOps tools e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab, Linux Command Line, Shell, etc.    Excellent communication and teamwork skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical collaborators.    Experience leading workshops, training sessions, and presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences.       Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:     Experience with Agentic AI frameworks, tools, and protocols e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, MCP.    Understand Multimodal LLMs, VLMs, etc.    Experience in deploying LLM models at scale on mainstream cloud providers (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).    Proven track record to profile and optimize inference latency and throughput, memory and I/O utilization.    Mathematical understanding of different parallelisation techniques in Gen AI       Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits . The overall objective of this role is to drive central program coordination, LOB engagement management, intake qualification, delivery milestone tracking, and 2LOD risk/governance alignment across all factory operations, maintaining close operational ties with Group-Wide AI PMO, Model Risk Management (MRM), and CISO Threat Operations. Leads LOB engagement management, scoping sessions, intake qualification, and SLA tracking for AI agent project requests across Markets, Services, Banking, PBWM, and Risk/Operations.    Establishes and oversees program-level dashboards tracking delivery velocity, stage-gate approvals, token consumption economics (via R2D2 Gateway), inference cost efficiency, and realized business ROI. Qualifications:   10+ years of relevant experience in technical program management, with significant experience managing complex, high-visibility enterprise technology initiatives. title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Autonomous Vehicles Platform
description_html: NVIDIA is defining the next era of computing, tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to power computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Our DRIVE platform gives automakers, Tier 1 suppliers, and start-ups the power and flexibility to develop and deploy breakthrough AI systems for autonomous vehicles — today powering over 270 partners in the development of autonomous cars, trucks, shuttles, and taxis!   We are looking for a creative and experienced Senior Technical Program Manager to join the NVIDIA DRIVE AV Platform team and help bring NVIDIA's autonomous vehicle platform to the world! You will lead a focused effort to productize groundbreaking solutions that will redefine transportation and the growing field of self-driving cars. You will work with dedicated multi-functional engineering teams across vehicle subsystems — software, hardware, validation, and systems — to integrate their work into our autonomous DRIVE SW platform, while achieving or exceeding all relevant NVIDIA and automotive standards & guidelines. The work is exciting, impactful, and fast-paced. We have customers and competition.    What you'll be doing:    Lead multiple, concurrent complex programs & projects across the autonomous driving platform.  Drive new platform technologies from bringup to production across software, hardware, vehicle, and validation teams.  Manage automotive software development and releases in a highly dynamic environment.  Define scope and manage project roadmaps, schedules, and milestones with cross-functional engineering teams.  Handle risks and resolve issues that affect release scope, schedule, and quality.  Identify and manage cross-functional dependencies proactively.  Improve processes and procedures within the team. Streamline day-to-day operations.  Communicate regularly to manage expectations and provide timely updates on progress, risks, and decisions.     What we need to see:    BS/MS in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience)  12+ years of industry and Technical Program Management experience in software engineering and releasing commercial products.  Track record of delivering scalable programs and process improvements in fast-paced, multi-functional environments.  Experience driving adoption of new and improved process workflows.  Strong technical acumen across software and hardware platforms.  Strong communication, organizational, and leadership skills.  Self-starter with a “can-do” attitude.     Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:    Previous experience & lived a life as a software developer or software QA engineer. Understand the pressures they are under, allowing you to more optimally lead them in projects as well as process.  Background in embedded systems (OS, platform drivers, sensors, middleware) or other software close to the hardware stack.  Experience in Automotive system integration.  Experience with Jira and/or JAMA, to the point that you can be comfortable mentoring an engineering team how to use these tools with agility.  Expertise in Agile and Scrum methodology.
